UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile, theme preference, and owner-controlled status.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: User display name from Google Sign-In.

darkTheme.description: Whether Midnight Dark theme is enabled.

suspended.description: Whether the owner has suspended this user's access.

ownerNote.description: Optional administrative note written exclusively by the owner.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Saved conversation message belonging to a single user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

generatedImage.description: True if this entry represents an AI-generated image caption.

OwnerAppConfig.title: OwnerAppConfig
OwnerAppConfig.description: Live app-wide settings and AI directives controlled exclusively by the app owner.

announcement.description: Optional broadcast message shown to all signed-in users.

ownerDirective.description: Custom AI assistant command/directive applied across the app.

dailyImageLimit.description: Daily AI image generation quota per user (1-50).

maintenanceMode.description: When true, non-owner users see a maintenance screen.

updatedBy.description: Owner email or UID who last modified settings.

/users/{userId}.description: User profiles readable/manageable by the owner or owning user.

/users/{userId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Conversation message history scoped to user and observable/manageable by the owner.

/appConfig/{configId}.description: Global application settings doc (settings) writable only by the owner.
